mode: Generation using an existing project outfit reference
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset: Full-screen GREEDILOUS brand presentation website opening, a photoreal fashion-show concept image. Landscape 16:9, ideally 2560 by 1440.
Reference role: The supplied image is an OUTFIT PRINT / COLOUR / BRAND ENERGY reference only. It is not a pose or background to preserve.
Create one coherent high-fashion runway photograph: three distinct fictional adult female models walking naturally in single file toward the runway photographer, with realistic depth and spacing, not duplicated cutouts. The lead model is near the center, slightly left at 43% of the image width, and the two following models recede behind her near 53% and 59%. Full bodies and shoes visible. Calm commanding runway expressions, anatomically correct hands and walking legs, professional show styling.
Collection: preserve the reference's maximalist graphic identity — bold navy-and-ivory checks, saturated crimson floral prints, vivid yellow and cobalt accents, pop-art collage textures. Lead look: a sharply tailored printed jacket over a fluid matching skirt, with burgundy platforms. Following looks vary the silhouette (a long printed dress and structured short dress) while sharing the same exuberant check/floral print language. Believable premium fabric, motion in hems, no giant accessories.
Environment: an actual-looking indoor fashion-show venue, a long glossy oxblood-red catwalk, dark low audience rows on BOTH sides, receding overhead spotlights and a softly glowing burgundy backdrop. Audience is indistinct and secondary. White spotlights sculpt the models and show the fabric texture; restrained red bounce light and realistic reflections on the runway floor.
Composition for the website: an immersive wide shot from the runway end at low-to-mid camera height. Keep all faces between 16% and 35% of image height, below the top-center navigation area. Keep the lead model entirely within the middle 30–65% of the image width so a centered portrait crop remains useful. Models occupy upper and middle portions; lower 25% is predominantly dark red runway floor with subdued reflections, suitable for overlaid white editorial copy. Bold image, polished fashion photography, rich material texture, sharp clothing, controlled contrast, natural skin.
Do not draw any typography, captions, large wordmarks, watermarks, logos, graphic symbols or presentation UI. No hovering or leaping poses, no repeated identical people, no pasted collage panels, no fantasy scenery. This is an invented fashion-show concept, not a claimed photograph of a specific real event.
status: AI-generated fashion-show concept; not a documentary photograph of an actual event
